name: ETL Amazon S3 To MySQL
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Amazon S3 as the data source.
2.  Select your added MySQL data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.
